title: OrganizationalRelation
description: docs/canonical/TZ-00-domain-event-canon.md, section 19e.7, PACK-08 implementation round. Multiple typed directed graphs between Organizations - a simple tree is not authoritative. relation_type is one of nine values across three derived relation_category groups: hierarchy (parent_of, subordinate_to - cycles forbidden without exception), continuity (successor_of, merged_into, split_from - append-only, never implies automatic role/authority transfer), cooperation (affiliated_with, temporary_supervision_by, operates_within, participates_in - general graph, mutual affiliated_with edges permitted, temporary_supervision_by may not cycle). Owned by organization-service (epd2_organization_service.domain.OrganizationalRelation). Every historical relation remains queryable - current state never overwrites it.
